notes.title: Active Neurons is available Now
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1168630/

[b]About the game:[/b]

Active Neurons is a game that trains spatial logical thinking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28130104/f2a71ede3afb680abe60e8cf9c3ce819fba570d8.png[/img]

By controlling the power of thought, you must charge neurons. The more charged neurons, the healthier our brain. The healthier the brain, the more fully-fledged life a person lives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28130104/833ac553fd8624652d1adf58e4a5db6258c3e89e.gif[/img]

It would seem that the task is very simple, but no. To choose the direction of movement, the power of thought should be at rest, so it is important for you to correctly use obstacles on the levels.

Avoid dangerous red thoughts, they are destructive.

Unlock doors to new spaces by contacting yellow neuron. 

Destroy destructive red thoughts with positive green thoughts. 

Teleport from one space to another using purple neurotransmitters.

Think, make a decision and look for the right path to neurons to charge them!


[b]Main Features:[/b]

[list][*]80 logical tasks;
[*]more than 10 types of unique mechanics;
[*]meditative music that creates an additional atmosphere in the game;
[*]Support for color blindness mode[/list]


[b]A little information about the work of the brain and neurons:[/b]

Our brain works much like a computer without the chip. Neurons are the primary components of the nervous system. They send and receive information in the form of electrical signals from the sensory organs, facilitating communication with the brain.

Nothing in the human body happens without the neurons knowing about it. Neurons perform the critical task of carrying information across the entirety of the human body.

The nerve cells transfer information by using both electrical and chemical signals.

The death of brain neurons can lead to irreversible diseases (e.g. Parkinson's disease)

Do not forget to charge your brains! This is exactly what you need to do in the game, while simultaneously charging the neurons in real life!

notes.title: Grass Cutter is now FREE-TO-PLAY
notes.content:
Hello friends!
[h1][b]The game is now FREE[/b][/h1]
I put a lot of effort, time and love into the development of the game. The game has a very high rating, which makes me happy, but there are big problems with the number of downloads, which is very frustrating. Maybe life is fair. I will let you judge.

I would like to see as many people as possible able to play Grass Cutter. So I decided to distribute the game for free on Steam. 

[b]Everyone who bought the game before received free DLC as compensation[/b]

I really hope for your understanding.
I love you all!
I bid you all a very fond farewell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28130104/f3c97e15a29b1f9ca9afbd2ae458589d45faa545.png[/img]

notes.title: Grass Cutter v.1.1.0. Thanks for the help!
notes.content:
Dear friends, from the moment of the publishing of a game many changes, improvements and corrections have been made. Thank you for your feedback - it helps us improve the game! ;) Each of you is very expensive to me!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28130104/184c7aaa870d48e9d3a48049df64f23219a6438a.gif[/img]

[b] Improvements: [/b]
[list]
    [*]The buttons for using the drones are adjusted to the control convenient for you 
( WASD + [,][.][/] or arrows + [z][x][c] ).
    [*]Improve navigation in the game.
    [*]Adding hints and notifications into a game;
    [*]Adding achievements list;
    [*]Small graphical improvements;
    [*]Fixed micro freezes when moving the camera and the drone
    [*]Improved Smartgrass Behavior.
    [*]When you hit the secret level from the gameground, return to the main levels after it ends.
 [/list]

[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug with the disappearance of the information panel on the game screen.
    [*]Unattainable achievement “Strong assistant”
    [*]When the controller was changed to the keyboard, WASD was not displayed in the management interface
    [*]Purchase a lawn mower after leaving the store. [url=https://youtu.be/JRzS1d2ou60?t=7m24s] Sample of a bug[/url]
    [*]Fixed small bugs;
[/list]

[b]Added 5 languages:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Español;
    [*]Italiano;
    [*]Deutsch;
    [*]Français;
    [*]Português.
 [/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28130104/2d4ca672d89c82c97af350e2b253ff44c3984093.gif[/img]
